articles.title: Europe's 27-Year Eclipse Drought Ends: A Total Solar Spectacle Is About to Dazzle Millions
articles.summary: On August 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse will sweep across Greenland, Iceland, and Spain—the first visible from mainland Europe since 1999. The two-minute totality will reveal the Sun's corona, and Spain is set for an unprecedented eclipse triple-header.

articles.title: Prelim Fireworks: Brito's Butterfly Blitz and Lee's Dominance Highlight Junior Nationals Day 5
articles.summary: Day 5 prelims at the 2026 U.S. Junior Nationals saw Gabi Brito unleash a blistering butterfly split to lead the girls' 200 IM, while Syunta Lee aims to double up after his 400 IM win. The 50 free fields are stacked with speedsters like Stella Canoles and Brody Chandler.

articles.title: Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Conquers the Billion-Dollar Box Office—And China Is Next
articles.summary: In just three weeks, Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' has grossed over $1 billion globally, becoming his first film since 'The Dark Knight Rises' to hit that milestone. With a China release imminent, it's poised to become his highest-grossing film ever.
